candidates.name: Geodesy and positioning
verified_facts: OS describes the national geodetic infrastructure as separate components: OS Net realises ETRS89, OSTN15 links to OSGB36 National Grid, Fundamental Bench Marks define ODN and OSGM15 realises height datums from GNSS coordinates.
These reference components provide the national framework for positioning and heighting.
semantic_limits: A national reference framework supplies coordinate/datum infrastructure but is not a parcel terrain observation and does not replace local survey or DTM sampling uncertainty.

candidates.name: Introduction to OS Net
verified_facts: OS describes OS Net as a nationwide GNSS base-station network providing a stable national coordinate reference system.
Its fundamental GeoNet stations are installed for high stability, preferably into exposed bedrock or founded until bedrock is reached.
semantic_limits: Stable national control monuments reduce reference-frame uncertainty but do not measure the parcel surface itself; local observation, antenna, transformation, raster and geometry errors remain required in the result budget.
